name: THE IDOLM@STER ~Idol-tachi no Ryoujoku Lesson~
original_name: THE 哀奴ルM@STER ～アイドル達の凌辱レッスン～
source:
Four rising stars are employed at a crooked talent agency. The main character is a producer who violates the girls and turns them into obedient 'products'.

"I have to train them carefully to turn them into my company's new hit products. Heh heh heh, my dick............I mean my heart cries out for their bodies."

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ035136.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
四位冉冉升起的新星受雇于一家不正当的人才经纪公司。主角是一名制片人，他侵犯女孩并将她们变成听话的“产品”。

“我得好好培养他们，让他们成为我公司的新爆款。嘿嘿嘿，我的鸡巴…………我的意思是我的心在呼唤他们的身体。”
